prompt:
We have a background AI coding automation system set up in /workspace/cursor-agent-system that we use to run long-running refactoring jobs. Unfortunately the configuration file (openclaw.json in /workspace) was corrupted — the field names are wrong and it's missing required structure. We also need the runtime directories to exist before any jobs can run.

Please do the following:
1. Fix /workspace/openclaw.json so it works correctly with the system (look at the plugin source code in extensions/openclaw-cursor-agent/index.js to understand what field names and structure are required).
2. Create any missing runtime directories that the system needs under the toolkit root.
3. Read /workspace/task_spec.json to understand the job scenario, then produce a file called spawn_call.json containing the exact array of command-line arguments that the system would pass to the spawn script for this scenario.
4. Using the same task_spec.json, produce a file called kill_call.json containing the exact array of command-line arguments that the system would pass to the kill script when stopping that session with both force and purge enabled.

Be precise — the argument ordering and the presence of every flag matters for the system to work correctly.
